digest.component_or_area: review-bot comment-added event plumbing and eligibility gating
propositions: A `recheck-review` comment must trigger a forced re-review of the current patchset only if the latest LLM-Review vote is a coverage-gap veto (llm-unavailable, review-error, scanner, indeterminate, gate-disabled, or exhausted-retry escalation); a real finding BLOCK must be refused with a message and no enqueue.

The eligibility decision must be made server-side from durable Gerrit state (the bot's persisted change message tag), never from contributor-controlled input, such that a contributor cannot forge or bypass the finding-refusal security property.

The tag parser must correctly classify all three production tag shapes: _TAG_SUFFIXES members, the hardcoded merge-review literal, and tags carrying in-bracket (merge-change, N) suffix; unparseable or absent tags must be treated as eligible (fail-open to fresh fail-closed review).
The reply path must post a message-only comment body with no `labels` key to avoid triggering a vote write or label displacement.
The `/rerun` operator endpoint and the `recheck-review` comment trigger must both reset the 0347 retry-attempt budget before enqueueing, harmonizing the shared retry bound.
The bot's own comments and comments not containing the word-boundary `recheck-review` token must be silently skipped with no reply or enqueue.
